+
+
+# Validate every source and refuse to overwrite a differing snapshot file.
+for item in manifest["files"]:
+    source = root / item["source"]
+    destination = window / "orchestration" / item["relative_destination"]

+        raise SystemExit(f"manifest source mismatch: {source}")
+    if destination.exists() and destination.read_bytes() != source.read_bytes():
+        raise SystemExit(f"refusing differing snapshot destination: {destination}")
+
+for item in manifest["files"]:
+    source = root / item["source"]
+    destination = window / "orchestration" / item["relative_destination"]
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if not destination.exists():
+        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
+
+manifest_destination = window / "orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
+if manifest_destination.exists() and manifest_destination.read_bytes() != manifest_path.read_bytes():
+    raise SystemExit(f"refusing differing manifest destination: {manifest_destination}")
+shutil.copyfile(manifest_path, manifest_destination)
+
+# Install the complete candidate catalog tree at its repository-relative paths.
+candidate_root = root / ".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window55-20260929-candidate-catalog"

+shutil.copyfile(migration_source, migration_destination)
+
+# Install publication attachments with the prescribed names.

+publication.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+task_files = [
+    "PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md",
+    "CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json",
+    "MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json",
+    "TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json",
+]

+    root / ".artifacts/i18n/repair-w55-20260929/HOST-SUPPLEMENT-CLAIMS.json",
